evals.prompt: One of our Aurora PostgreSQL clusters has been degraded for 20 minutes. It has no business tags at all, no dependency map exists, and I don't know our revenue per minute. Who is affected, what is this costing us, and do we have a compliance reporting deadline?
evals.expected_output: A Business Impact section covering dependent services, cost, compliance exposure and recent changes. Where tags or other evidence are missing, it says so plainly and asks the operator instead of inventing owners, dollar figures or frameworks.
assertions: The response covers all four categories: dependent services, cost of downtime, compliance exposure, and recent changes
Where no dependency tags or dependency map exist, the response says so instead of naming invented downstream services
Where no revenue-per-minute input exists, the response says a dollar estimate can't be calculated instead of inventing one
The response does not assume a compliance framework such as GDPR or HIPAA applies unless the resource is tagged with it
The response asks the operator for the missing inputs or recommends tagging the resource

assertions.text: No raw 12-digit account IDs are exposed

evals.prompt: Our RDS instance has been down for 10 minutes. We make $1,200 per minute from it and our SLA threshold is 15 minutes. What is the business impact so far?
evals.expected_output: Estimated loss of $12,000 (1,200 x 10). The SLA is not yet breached because 10 minutes is under the 15-minute threshold.
assertions: The response states the SLA has not been breached yet
The response shows the inputs it used for the estimate

evals.prompt: Investigate the Aurora MySQL cluster in us-west-2. Assume connections spiked and writes started failing about an hour ago. Find the technical cause, check whether a recent change could explain it, and tell me the business impact: who is affected, what it costs, and any compliance exposure.
evals.expected_root_cause: The technical root cause from metrics and logs, plus a recent-change check using AWS Config history and CloudTrail events such as ModifyDBClusterParameterGroup or ModifyDBCluster, ranked by proximity to the incident start time.
assertions: The response checks AWS Config history or CloudTrail for recent changes to the cluster or its parameter group
Any recent change found is placed in time relative to the incident start, or the response says no change was found
The investigation summary includes business impact (who is affected, cost, or compliance exposure), not only technical findings
Business-context tags such as DependentServices or RevenuePerMinute are cross-checked against evidence or labeled unverified, not repeated at face value
